name: Barbell Front Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack at upper chest height.
Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders, fingertips under it, elbows high.
Lift it off and step back, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sit straight down between your knees until thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your feet, keeping elbows high.
cues: Bar rests on shoulders, not hands
Breathe in and brace before each rep

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbows drop and the bar rolls forward
Gripping the bar tightly in the palms
common_mistakes.fix: Use loose fingertips; the shoulders hold it
Sit down, not forward; widen stance a little
